en.hubeali:
And by his chain, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> fascinated by the gourd in the pots, and it is the pumpkin’.
en.sarwar: 2. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith, the following is narrated: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, liked calabash, gourd in the cooking pot. It is squash.”’
